notes.body:
# Settings and smarter police

New settings, an option to reduce flashing, and police that cut you off better.

- A new settings screen with graphics presets and accessibility options
- Reduce flashing: police lights sway instead of strobing
- Smaller updates from now on
- Interceptors hold the intersection until you pass

Your settings and scores are kept.
